subject: RRO 3.2.2 and RStudio preview 0.99.688 not playing well together

messages.author: 9c36e191a2423678
messages.subject: RRO 3.2.2 and RStudio preview 0.99.688 not playing well together
parts: After installing RStudio preview 0.99.688, I cannot exit RStudio without manually going to the console window and quitting the R session. A note has been submitted on the RStudio website about this. I expect the problem lies with an incompatibility between RRO and the latest preview releases of RStudio.

messages.subject: Re: RRO 3.2.2 and RStudio preview 0.99.688 not playing well together
parts: Got a solution to this. It was NOT an RRO problem. I reproduced it using CRAN R. I got a solution from RStudio. It is to remove your ~/.rstudio-desktop folder. That requires you to reset preferences, but we should probably do that once in a while anyway. I've also fowarded my old .rstudio-desktop folder to the folks at RStudio in hopes they can figure out what caused the issue.
